Good service makes the difference
Jul 2025 • Friends
I’ve been to Al Fresco’s many times. Honestly, the pizza is average, and the food overall is okay, but there are many options to choose from, which is why I keep coming back.

Had dinner tonight at Al Fresco’s Vincom. The spaghetti was decent, but the steak was not tender. When the staff asked how things were, I mentioned the steak wasn’t good, and I was surprised when she offered to change it for me. I didn’t expect that! In the end, they explained the steak would be the same cut if replaced, so it was quite funny.

What stood out tonight was the service. Minh Anh, the staff taking care of my table, was attentive, detailed, and genuinely cared about customers. She also took great care of other tables around us, which left a good impression.

Thank you, Minh Anh, for your kindness and great attitude. It made the dinner feel much better despite the steak not being perfect. Keep up the good work!

A great view of the Dragon Bridge with good food
Nov 2023 • Family
I ordered the full garden salad with House vinaigrette - on pony deliciousness (see pic half eaten).

We ordered a thick crust Margarita pie, it was good, I would have preferred more sauce but it was good - the crust is rated a 7 of 10.

We ordered the Korean spicy chicken, very unique with the batter more resembling a Japanese Tempura… Very unique flavor, texture/ascetic.

We sat upstairs for the best bridge view, very scenic. It was warm when we arrived but it cooled down within about 15 minutes. 

I had a peach tea, very tasty with a sliced half peeled peach floating- really yummy.

Overall, it was a good meal and atmosphere with attentive service. Pricing is a bit on the high end for Danang, no regrets on the visit.

Highly recommend

Unpleasant X’Mas Eve given by Head brand area manger
Dec 2021 • Family
To: Country Director of Al fresco’s

I just want to write to let you know that I am happy to see you reopen the business at Vincom center in Da Nang. It is crowded today and I am of the the regular guests at this place.
We went there this evening after a long lockdown and happy to see happy welcoming faces as usual from your staff, but one incident happened today as my wife and myself walking in Alfresco with a baby stroller and the stroller hit a foreigner. I said “oh I’m sorry “ with big smile (we have been home since the baby born, and frankly I push the stroller for the first time), he turned back and said with an angry 😡 face “It is not funny “ loud and clear which scares me and my baby. I didn’t say anything more since I am with an infant of three months. We finished the meal with good dishes as usual (although they ran out of pizza 😢 because too crowded as they didn’t expect that many people turned out because covid). When we got the bill I asked the staff “Who is the foreigner do you know? The man (has left) the amenity is our brand area manager in Da Nang 😳😳🤒🤒🤒. It was my shocking surprise to know that. I don’t believe he’s wearing normal shirt with short with no name tag so I don’t recognize he’s one of staff.
I just want to ask the Country Director (as I am Vietnamese not familiar with Western culture, should I be crying and beg him for forgiveness? Can I just say I am sorry and smile as everyone should do the same when we tumble on each other especially at Xmas 🤶 evening?
As my wife observation he seems got some drink when he came (he came just for 15 minutes and rushed out). 
I must say that all your other staff that we usually meet are friendly with good service but that foreigner. He got a cunning face possibly he has to work on this X mas night. I don’t know my Xmas mood just came down to zero when I got out Alfresco amenity 🤧😢🤧. I hope he’s not representing service attitude in Da Nang area.
